scope: Serialization and inference equivalence checks, not a quality benchmark

adapted_raw_text.scope: Reload all backbones and adapters; compare raw-text prediction against cached validation export

relocated_bundle.scope: Raw text through relocated inference-only bundle matches original validation export

frozen_raw_text.scope: Raw-text frozen export reproduces cached matched-baseline probability

bert_optimizer_rng_recovery.scope: Replay one discarded fit-data update after restoring adapter, AdamW state and CPU/MPS RNG from the final checkpoint

mistral_optimizer_recovery.scope: One update after optimizer+adapter reload with deterministic order and zero dropout on identical next example
